organizations.name: Anduril
organizations.oneLiner: Defense technology company building autonomous systems and the Lattice software platform.

focusNow.text: In June 2026 the U.S. Army selected Anduril to lead the common data baseline for NGC2.
Won an Air Force production contract for its Fury (YFQ-44A) collaborative combat aircraft in June 2026.
The first Ohio-built Fury rolled off the Arsenal-1 production line in Pickaway County on July 27, 2026.
The Army awarded it a contract worth up to $1.8 billion over five years to expand NGC2 to more units.

organizations.hiring: Paid engineering, software and manufacturing internships plus new-grad roles; see anduril.com/early-careers.

organizations.name: Cloudflare
organizations.oneLiner: Connectivity cloud company offering CDN, security and a serverless developer platform.

focusNow.text: Marked its 16th birthday with 46 announcements across open source, security, AI agents and its developer platform.
Launched Cloudflare Basin, a data analytics platform for developers, now generally available.
Introduced K2, a durable serverless event stream.
Introduced an Agent Development Lifecycle for taking agentic software from prototype to production.

organizations.eventRole: table 4; speaker: 2pm panel on edge computing
organizations.hiring: Aims to hire 1,111 interns in 2026; its Early Talent program covers interns and new graduates.

organizations.name: Vercel
organizations.oneLiner: Frontend cloud platform for building, deploying and scaling web apps and AI products.

focusNow.text: Announced AI SDK 7 at its Ship 2026 conference in Berlin.
Its 2026 AI Accelerator cohort includes 39 early-stage teams and over $8M in partner credits.
AI Gateway provides access to hundreds of AI models through a single API key.
Publishes a monthly AI Gateway production index on how developers use AI models.
